notes.title: Post AVCon update
notes.notes:
[p]A HUGE THANK YOU TO EVERYONE WHO VISITED US AT AVCON AND/OR DONATED TO GETTING TO PAXAUS SO FAR.[/p][p][/p][p]An updated build is released for those that weren't able to join us at AVCon you may notice quite a few changes to the UI, Art, Colouring and overall flow of the game. Keep on jumping![/p][p]Tumbles & The Crew
[/p]

notes.title: Demo 0.1c update
notes.notes:
Firstly the team would all love to say thank you to everyone who has jumped into the Silk Soar Demo and given feedback on the game so far. 


[list]
[*] A Storm has rolled through the rainforest and adjusted the early gameplay to give an improved difficulty level to early-level gameplay. Tumbles cannot wait to see people finishing the demo and posting their best scores.

[*] Tumbles wanted to show people his evolutions earlier and as such you will now receive an automatic evolution the first time you collect a rambutan.

[*] Collecting the narrative leaves was also giving Tumbles a headache. Tumbles will now get himself to a safer spot, rather than often falling after collecting the leaves.

[/list]
Thanks once again and we hope you enjoy the new changes, feel free to use the in-game feedback or contact us if Tumbles needs some more help.

notes.title: DEMO RELEASE!!!!!
notes.notes:
Hey there Slingers!
Tumbles has been practising his flinging everywhere since SAGE and has now recorded a trailer for you all.
Voiced by the amazing Jake Bresanello, (Cornelius - Winton's Dad in Bluey) the team hopes you enjoy the trailer as much as we have.
For those that were able to visit and play at a convention, you can now explore at home, with levels and art adjusted and your chance to complete the demo and receive a special demonstration of your skill you can share with others.

Thank you to everyone who has been involved and we can't wait to expand further on Silk Soar and bring the whole story to our players.

Stout Heart Games
